cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: I’ve Done This Before
cards.instruction: Perform calm familiarity with the task while learning how it works from every new clue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. We'll have this tent up before the rain. I'm familiar with these sleeves.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: This one has clips. The poles cross first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Yes, the clip system. Cross the poles; then we attach the fabric.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That fabric's the outer cover. We're standing on the inner tent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Step off the inner tent and we'll raise it first. I always lay everything out.

mechanism: A learns the tent assembly from B successive corrections while presenting each newly understood step as familiar procedure B must follow precisely.
confusable: Simple incompetence admits uncertainty; A remains calmly authoritative and corrects B using the information B just supplied.
comparison: Coffee alternative learns hidden controls; tent alternative misidentifies components and changes assembly order under rain pressure.
seedUse: Sleeves versus clips, crossing poles and inner/outer fabric derive from D42-b; S03 adds concrete order and handling instructions.
